Route: Intramuscular

3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 70-year-old male received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 03 November 2024. Approximately 6 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Pericarditis. The patient sought medical attention and was treated in the emergency department. The outcome was recovered with sequelae. The reporter considers the event related to mRNA-1273 vaccination.
